name: image_ideogram4_t2i
description: Ideogram 4.0 — a 9.3B open-weights text-to-image foundation model with day-zero ComfyUI support. Reads a STRUCTURED JSON PROMPT (not plain text) as a spec sheet: scene summary, style block, hex color palettes, and per-element bounding boxes for precise layout and readable in-image text. Runs the Qwen3-VL 8B text encoder + flux2-vae, with asymmetric classifier-free guidance over a conditional + unconditional UNET pair (DualModelGuider) on the Ideogram4Scheduler (Default preset: 20 res_multistep steps, mu=0.0, std=1.75). Heavy local model: two fp8 diffusion checkpoints (~9.3B each) plus an 8B encoder. NOTE: Ideogram 4.0 has a safety filter baked into the model weights — a blocked/blank result is the model's own filter, not ComfyUI; rephrase the offending element rather than retrying verbatim.
